version.changelog: Remove read-only switch and approval tiers; read/write authz delegated to RBAC. New guard()/audit_call() core.

llm.summary: This is a coherent VMware audit and policy helper, but it needs review because it documents broad policy bypass and fail-open behavior for a security-control component.

dimensions.detail: Local audit storage and environment-variable inspection are purpose-aligned for audit attribution, but audit rows can include parameters, results, username, workflow ID, and detected agent, so operational data may persist locally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is via uv tool install of the vmware-policy package and the artifact itself contains only markdown documentation, but it is a community package and auto-installed as a dependency by related VMware skills.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses its audit logging, local database, agent detection, and rules behavior, but it also tells operators how to bypass PolicyDenied with VMWARE_POLICY_DISABLED=1 without requiring explicit admin approval or bounded scope.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists audit data in ~/.vmware/audit.db with rotation and hot-reloads ~/.vmware/rules.yaml, while documented bypass and missing-dependency fail-open paths can disable enforcement broadly.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The audit, policy, and sanitization capabilities fit the stated VMware infrastructure purpose, but the same artifacts document an all-policy bypass and fail-open allowance that materially weaken the policy-enforcement role.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing in production. Ensure PyYAML is installed, create and test ~/.vmware/rules.yaml, restrict who can set VMWARE_POLICY_DISABLED, monitor ok_bypassed audit entries, and protect ~/.vmware/audit.db because it may contain sensitive operational details.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: Agent detection by environment-variable presence is disclosed and used for audit attribution; it does not claim to store API key values, but using OPENAI_API_KEY as a signal is broader than necessary.
[SQP-2] expected: Audit logging of parameters, results, workflow IDs, usernames, and status is central to the skill and is documented as local SQLite storage, though users should treat the logs as sensitive operational records.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The documented VMWARE_POLICY_DISABLED=1 switch bypasses all policy checks; even though bypassed operations are logged, this is a high-impact escape hatch for a policy-enforcement component.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The setup guide says missing rules allow all operations and missing PyYAML silently allows all operations, which can make users believe enforcement is active when it is not.
